Information Note to the Press (Press Release No 145/ 2026) 
For Immediate Release  
Telecom Regulatory Authority of India 
TRAI releases draft 'Guidelines on Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence 
(Al) in Telecommunication Networks and Provision of Telecommunication 
Services' for stakeholders' comments 
New Delhi, 30.10.2026 — Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has today 
released draft 'Guidelines on Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (AT) in 
Telecommunication Networks and Provision of Telecommunication Services' for 
stakeholders' comments. 
2. In February 2026, the Government of India released the 'India Al Governance 
Guidelines' with the goal to harness the transformative potential of artificial intelligence 
for inclusive development and global competitiveness, while addressing risks it may 
pose to individuals and society. The guidelines are anchored in seven guiding sutras 
or principles — Trust i the Foundation, People First, Innovation over Restraint, 
Fairness & Equity, Accountability, Understandable by Design, and Safety, Resilience & 
Sustainability. Part 4 of the guidelines provides practical guidance for industry actors 
and regulators to increase clarity, predictability and accountability in the ecosystem. 
3. The telecommunication sector constitutes a significant part of India's digital 
infrastructure. Today, the telecommunication sector supports connectivity for the 
public, delivery of public and essential e-services, conduct of trade and commerce, and 
secure and resilient functioning of the country's critical information infrastructure. It is 
critical not only for social, economic and commercial activities but also for national 
security and emergency response in the country.

Information Note to the Press (Press Release No. 145/2026) 
For Immediate Release 
Telecom Regulatory Authority of India 
TRAI releases draft 'Guidelines on Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence 
(AI) in Telecommunication Networks and Provision of Telecommunication 
Services' for stakeholders' comments. 
New Delhi, 30.10.2026 - Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has today 
released draft 'Guidelines on Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in 
Telecommunication Networks and Provision of Telecommunication Services' for 
stakeholders' comments. 
2. In February 2026, the Government of India released the 'India AI Governance 
Guidelines' with the goal to harness the transformative potential of artificial intelligence 
for inclusive development and global competitiveness, while addressing risks it may 
pose to individuals and society. The guidelines are anchored in seven guiding sutras 
or principles - Trust is the Foundation, People First, Innovation over Restraint, 
Fairness & Equity, Accountability, Understandable by Design, and Safety, Resilience & 
Sustainability. Part 4 of the guidelines provides practical guidance for industry actors 
and regulators to increase clarity, predictability and accountability in the ecosystem. 
3. The telecommunication sector constitutes a significant part of India's digital 
infrastructure. Today, the telecommunication sector supports connectivity for the 
public, delivery of public and essential e-services, conduct of trade and commerce, and 
secure and resilient functioning of the country's critical information infrastructure. It is 
critical not only for social, economic and commercial activities but also for national 
security and emergency response in the country. 
Page 1 of 2 
4. At present, Al is increasingly being integrated into telecommunication networks 
and provision of telecommunication services. With a view to ensuring consistent and 
responsible implementation of the India Al Governance Guidelines in the 
telecommunication sector, and to increase clarity, predictability and accountability in 
the ecosystem, TRAI has decided to frame guidelines on responsible use of Al in 
telecommunication networks and provision of telecommunication services after 
following stakeholders' consultation. 
5. In this regard, a draft of the Guidelines on Responsible Use of Artificial 
Intelligence (Al) in Telecommunication Networks and Provision of 
Telecommunication Services has been placed on TRAI's website (www.trai.gov.in ) 
for seeking inputs from stakeholders. Written comments on the draft guidelines are 
invited from stakeholders by 27.11.2026 
6. The comments may be sent, preferably in electronic form to Shri Akhilesh Kumar 
Trivedi, Advisor (Networks, Spectrum & Licensing), TRAI, at advmn@trai.gov.in . For 
any clarification! information, Shri Akhilesh Kumar Trivedi, Advisor (Networks, 
Spectrum & Licensing), TRAI may be contacted at Telephone Number +91-11-
20907758. 
(Harinder Kumar) 
Secretary, TRAI
